title: Build fn-cloud-speech
notes: Claim 1 'each adapter returns text for the fixture audio': five tests openai_transcription_returns_text, deepgram_returns_text_and_sends_the_language, elevenlabs_scribe_returns_text, groq_returns_text, mistral_voxtral_returns_text (core/crates/ai-providers/tests/speech.rs:52-60, helper transcribes :28 asserts the text and that the audio bytes are in the request). Claim 2 'a refused key returns the provider's words': four refused-key tests, one per provider, :63-73 (helper refused :39 asserts reason_words equals the provider's words and not retryable). That is 5 + 5 refused (openai, deepgram, elevenlabs, groq, mistral) = 10, plus three guards (:76 empty recording, :88 missing key, :99 boundary) = 13 tests. The cargo line 'test result: ok. 13 passed' is the pass line. Recorded fixtures are replayed (Replay), no network.
